text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While passing behind the school
building, I spot
Air Groove and Seiun
Sky watering the flower
garden
together.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh? Well, this sure is some nice timing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, you look rather tired. All that
trainer work
must be real tough. Sooo...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Why not water the flowers with us? It's very relaxing. ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Sky. You're trying to push
your work
off onto someone else again.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, caught me red-handed. Sigh... All this watering is backbreaking...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's necessary to go and fetch
water
frequently, and the academy's
flower garden is
quite large, so yes, it
does take a lot of effort.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Isn't there some way to make this easier?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Like, we could make a drone fly over the
flowers
and water them all in one go!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Stop your scheming! My word, you'll go
to any
lengths to shirk your duties.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Besides, some plants will wither if their
flowers or
leaves are watered.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yikes... That sounds like a real pain.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, precisely. Come along now, less
chatter and
more watering.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're here to fill in for another student,
aren't
you? She's responsible for the
planters over there.
Make sure you water
those flowers properly, at
the very least.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Okaaay...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After being reminded that she's filling
in, Seiun
Sky gets back to work without
any fuss. Seeing
this, I can't help but
blurt out...

text_block_list.text:
This is all for the better. I do hope that
you'll
assist with watering on a regular
basis, Sky.
choice_data_list_en: (The Beautification Committee? If I remember correctlyâ)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I recommend it in daisy season. It's
especially
pleasant.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Maybe if I feel like it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It really is! I can't take it much longer!
And I
happily accept your help!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey! Goodness, will you never learn?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Look, it's really not healthy for me to
overexert
myself this much.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Isn't there something we can streamline?
Based on
what I've seen so far...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're certainly putting an awful lot of
thought
into this.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Are you... trying to lessen the
groundskeeping
committee's workload?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't be silly. I just really love
thinking up
new ways to take it easy.
